reds.definition:
n red color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of blood
n a tributary of the Mississippi River that flows eastward from Texas along the southern boundary of Oklahoma and through Louisiana
n emotionally charged terms used to refer to extreme radicals or revolutionaries
n the amount by which the cost of a business exceeds its revenue
reds.translation: n. [俚]红胶丸（安眠药的俚称）；红色的物品（red的复数）

redsear.definition: v. i. To be brittle when red-hot; to be red-short.
redsear.translation:
n. 热脆, 红脆
a. 热脆的, 红脆的

redshank.definition: n. a common Old World wading bird with long red legs

redshanks.definition:
plural of redshank

redshanks.translation: (redshank 的复数) n. 红脚鹬

redshift.definition: n (astronomy) a shift in the spectra of very distant galaxies toward longer wavelengths (toward the red end of the spectrum); generally interpreted as evidence that the universe is expanding
redshift.translation: n. （天体）红移, 红向移动

redshifted.translation: n. [天文学]红移[亦作red shift,参较cosmological redshift, doppler effect, gravitational redshift]

redshifts.definition:
plural of redshift
n (astronomy) a shift in the spectra of very distant galaxies toward longer wavelengths (toward the red end of the spectrum); generally interpreted as evidence that the universe is expanding
redshifts.translation: (redshift 的复数) n. （天体）红移, 红向移动

redskins.definition: n. (slang) offensive term for Native Americans
redskins.translation: n. 红皮肤人( redskin的复数形式 )
